name: Lyra
author: Project Lyra
description: A persistent jailbreak and modding platform for the Zune HD: the mod manager UI, zuxhook, nativeapp daemon, and its component mods (mods-tab, wifi-power, clock-date) all wrapped in a pretty bow.
changelog: Mods can now raise a selection list for a choice you are making right then, instead of only from their own settings row. Two mods that change the same part of the interface no longer cancel each other out.
